raw_text: URGENT: Reports of merchant vessel struck in Gulf of Aden approximately 60nm southwest of Aden. Vessel identified as bulk carrier MV True Confidence. Crew casualties reported. Houthi military spokesperson expected to claim responsibility shortly. This appears to be an anti-ship ballistic missile strike based on damage pattern.
clean_text: Merchant vessel MV True Confidence struck in Gulf of Aden 60nm southwest of Aden. Crew casualties reported. Damage pattern indicates anti-ship ballistic missile strike.
